text: Added PCA-backed ConfoundStrategy execution in shared scalafim-bids: selectStrategy cleans PCA/raw variables separately, imputes/standardizes PCA inputs, retains components by npcs or percent variance, appends raw strategy columns, and returns PCA metadata/loadings. Added shared strategy tests plus JVM loader fixture coverage against an fMRIPrep-like confound TSV. Updated BIDS docs/ecosystem plan. Verification: sbt bidsJVM/test bidsJS/test passed 30 JVM / 26 JS tests; sbt compileAll passed; sbt testAll passed.
